name: ds-skills
description: Skills for the Design System: token architecture (Foundation → Palette → Semantic), component workflows, and the designer-facing design suite (UI, UX, handoff, motion)
note: Lean registry. Extended metadata (intents, compose graph, io, gates) lives in skills.extended.json, keyed by skill name.

skills.name: contrast-check
skills.description: Verify color combinations meet WCAG accessibility contrast requirements. Supports AA (4.5:1) and AAA (7:1) levels.

skills.name: dark-mode-mapping
skills.description: CRITICAL - Map between light/dark mode ramp steps correctly. Documents the neutral ramp REVERSAL where step 50 and 1000 swap between white/black.

skills.name: ramp-generation
skills.description: Generate or modify color ramps with proper foundation references. Maintains consistent step intervals (50-1000) and applies OKLCH lightness modifiers.

skills.name: extend-ramps
skills.description: Extend the colour ranges of the white-label system: add a new accent tier, add shades to an existing ramp, add data-vis chart slots, and wire new tokens through source so a rebuild emits them across web and iOS.

skills.name: brief-updater
skills.description: Update agent briefs when skills change or patterns evolve. Propagates changes from skills library to brief references.

skills.name: handoff-protocol
skills.description: Standardize agent-to-agent handoffs with structured state transfer. Ensures context preservation and clear task boundaries.

skills.name: release-process
skills.description: Complete checklist for releasing a new Token Library version, including tokens, changelog, announcement, and Figma Make assets.

skills.name: rollback
skills.description: Safely revert token changes when issues are discovered. Supports commit/file/session level rollbacks with proper documentation.

skills.name: slack-announcements
skills.description: Create and format Slack release announcements for design system updates following the standard template.

skills.name: ui-kit-release-artifacts
skills.description: Create or update UI Kit release changelogs, Slack announcements, and Figma publish messages by compiling all per-component changelog entries since the last UI Kit publish date.

skills.name: dependency-graph
skills.description: Trace token references to build upstream/downstream dependency graphs. Detects circular references and calculates change impact.

skills.name: semantic-token-search
skills.description: Use search_tokens for intent-first token discovery, then narrow with precision filters for faster and more accurate context.

skills.name: token-lookup
skills.description: Find tokens by path, name pattern, or value. Returns metadata and location for efficient context gathering without reading full tokens.json.

skills.name: bulk-transform
skills.description: Apply batch transformations across multiple tokens with atomic commit and rollback. Requires human approval when affecting more than 10 tokens.

skills.name: description-guidelines
skills.description: Rules for writing token descriptions that maintain semantic abstraction and theme compatibility.

skills.name: safe-token-edit
skills.description: Safely edit tokens in tokens.json with validation gates. Includes pre-edit checklist, scripted approach, and post-edit validation.

skills.name: component-lifecycle-orchestration
skills.description: Mandatory orchestration workflow for Figma Executor on MAKE/UPDATE component tasks, including VS Code question gates, semver classification, multi-agent delegation, and release communications.

skills.name: design-extraction
skills.description: Figma Console MCP operating playbook with mode/status checks, tool routing, and FOM 2026 execution contracts for any Figma-facing task.

skills.name: design-linting
skills.description: Workflow for design quality and accessibility auditing using figma_lint_design and figma_audit_design_system before handoff.

skills.name: figma-api-reference
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/api-reference.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-common-patterns
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/common-patterns.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-component-patterns
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/component-patterns.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-console-mcp-integration
skills.description: End-to-end Figma Console MCP integration proposal and operating standard for setup, mode-aware execution, reliability gates, and deterministic troubleshooting.

skills.name: figma-effect-style-patterns
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/effect-style-patterns.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-gotchas
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/gotchas.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-make-workflow
skills.description: End-to-end workflow for building React components from Figma designs for Figma Make integration.

skills.name: figma-plugin-api-patterns
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/plugin-api-patterns.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-text-style-patterns
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/text-style-patterns.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-use
skills.description: MANDATORY prerequisite — load before every figma_execute (Console MCP) or use_figma (Desktop Bridge MCP) call. Covers Plugin API critical rules (17), incremental workflow, error recovery, pre-flight checklist, and Design System variable bindings. Reference docs cover gotchas, common patterns, component/variant patterns, variable patterns, plugin API patterns, text/effect style patterns, and complete API surface.

skills.name: figma-validation-and-recovery
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/validation-and-recovery.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-variable-patterns
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/variable-patterns.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-wwds
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/working-with-design-systems/wwds.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: figma-wwds-variables
skills.description: Reference skill for figma-integration/figma-use/references/working-with-design-systems/wwds-variables.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: token-mapping
skills.description: Map Figma design values to design system tokens dynamically using tokens.json as source of truth, with FOM 2026 MCP-aware mapping guidance.

skills.name: approval-workflow
skills.description: Manage approval workflow for token changes. Determines required labels, reviews, and sign-offs based on change type and scope.

skills.name: constraint-reference
skills.description: Complete reference of token system constraints and violations. Invoke when validating changes or unsure about rules.

skills.name: foundation-gate
skills.description: Compatibility wrapper delegating foundation layer decisions to token-modification-gates.

skills.name: palette-gate
skills.description: Compatibility wrapper delegating palette layer decisions to token-modification-gates.

skills.name: token-modification-gates
skills.description: Unified canonical gate for protected token layers (foundation and palette), including approval labels and escalation rules.

skills.name: accessibility
skills.description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance patterns for React components. Covers ARIA, keyboard navigation, and focus management.

skills.name: component-patterns
skills.description: Design patterns for composable React components. Covers compound components, render props, HOCs, and controlled/uncontrolled.

skills.name: hooks-quick-reference
skills.description: Compact decision matrix for built-in React hooks used in design system components.

skills.name: hooks-reference
skills.description: Custom hook architecture and safe hook composition patterns for design system components.

skills.name: state-management
skills.description: Patterns for managing state in React components from local state to complex state machines and context.

skills.name: testing
skills.description: Behavior-level unit and integration testing guidance for React components using Testing Library.

skills.name: typescript-patterns
skills.description: TypeScript patterns for React components including props typing, generics, and discriminated unions.

skills.name: shadcn-ui
skills.description: Build screens with the @ds/ui shadcn component library themed by the design-system tokens. Imports, theming contract, composition patterns.

skills.name: compose-screen
skills.description: Compose a designed product screen from the design system: tokens, material, captured design language and vendored blocks. Use to build a page/dashboard/feature that should look designed, not raw shadcn.

skills.name: react-loop
skills.description: ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) pattern for grounded problem-solving. Interleaves explicit reasoning traces with tool actions and observations.

skills.name: mobbin-mcp
skills.description: Mobbin MCP workflow for grounding component and pattern decisions in shipped product examples before reference or execution responses.

skills.name: npm-packages
skills.description: Curated list of battle-tested npm packages for React component development, organized by category.

skills.name: react-cheatsheet
skills.description: Quick reference for React patterns, hooks, TypeScript types, and common scenarios.

skills.name: token-reference-fast-path
skills.description: Deterministic MCP-only workflow for token reference queries with grouped table output.

skills.name: component-documentation
skills.description: Index skill. Delegates to component-documentation-writing (content) and component-documentation-figma (Figma/Storybook sync).

skills.name: component-documentation-figma
skills.description: Sync the canonical component doc to Figma configuration tables and Storybook controls. Enforces layout contracts, chip/plain-text formatting, and MCP safeguards.

skills.name: component-documentation-writing
skills.description: Write clear, multi-audience component docs (designers, developers, product owners) using the 9-section canonical structure. The component doc is the single source of truth.

skills.name: figma-to-storybook
skills.description: End-to-end workflow for translating Figma component designs into Storybook stories with all variants and states.

skills.name: natural-language-stories
skills.description: Generate Storybook stories and React components from plain English descriptions. Enables non-coders to create UI via prompting.

skills.name: story-writing
skills.description: Write Storybook stories using modern CSF3 format. Generates type-safe story files from component specs or designer descriptions.

skills.name: storybook-component-changelog-design
skills.description: Reference skill for storybook/component-changelog-design.md. Use when this exact subdomain is required; do not use as a generic replacement for procedural workflow skills.

skills.name: storybook-config
skills.description: Manage Storybook configuration — main.js, preview.js, addons, fonts, CSS token integration, dark mode toggle.

skills.name: token-showcase
skills.description: Create Storybook stories that visually showcase design tokens — colours, typography, spacing, shadows, and palettes.

skills.name: visual-regression-gate
skills.description: Mandatory post-task visual regression gate for Figma builds, visual prompt changes, and reference-output fidelity checks.

skills.name: visual-testing
skills.description: Set up and run accessibility, interaction, and visual tests in Storybook using play functions and a11y addon.

skills.name: build-verify
skills.description: Run npm build and test commands to verify token changes. Ensures JSON syntax, tests pass, and theme.js is generated correctly.

skills.name: constraint-check
skills.description: Verify token changes comply with constraint rules. Detects circular references, layer violations, and font weight format errors.

skills.name: json-validate
skills.description: Validate tokens.json JSON syntax and structural integrity.

skills.name: semantic-theme-parity
skills.description: Validate semantic theme parity required for Figma Variables export, including strict structural checks and advisory channel value decisions.

skills.name: token-audit-workflow
skills.description: Run audit_design_system to detect duplicate values, naming drift, and contrast risks before implementation or sign-off.

skills.name: ask-first-protocol
skills.description: Structured question format standard for agent-to-user decisions. Present every architectural decision, trade-off, ambiguity, or gate as structured options, not prose.

skills.name: component-doc-mcp-workflow
skills.description: Convert component property docs (Markdown) into Figma template updates via Figma Console MCP figma_execute. No plugin or REST API needed.

skills.name: figma-variables-implementation-guide
skills.description: Internalised Figma Help knowledge: variables vs styles, modes, scoping, and design token implementation in Figma. Foundational reference for figma-executor work.

skills.name: variable-binding-reference
skills.description: Design System Figma file keys, variable collections, and binding patterns. Internalised reference for figma-executor, including Token Library and UI Kit keys.

skills.name: token-governance-and-scaling
skills.description: Internalised industry knowledge on token system lifecycle, governance, and scaling. Foundational reference for architect-level governance decisions.

skills.name: design-token-naming-architecture
skills.description: Internalised industry knowledge on three-tier token naming architecture. Tool-agnostic foundational reference to load before planning token changes.

skills.name: design-dna
skills.description: The single source of truth for who the Design System is, how your brand designs, and what good design means here. Identity, content sections, design principles, anti-patterns, motion philosophy. Standalone prototyping companion and always-on preamble for every design/ skill.

skills.name: design-router
skills.description: Single entry point for design work. Classifies a designer's request into prototype, ui-craft, new-experience, handoff, or corpus-distill, loads the Design DNA, and composes the ordered skill sequence. Surfaced as /design.

skills.name: frame-to-spec
skills.description: Turn a Figma frame into a complete, no-questions-asked developer spec packet. Pulls layout, tokens, states, breakpoints, edge cases and a11y notes from the frame and renders them as a single Markdown file that links back to the Figma node.

skills.name: token-mapping-audit
skills.description: For a given Figma frame, list every raw colour, spacing, radius, type and shadow value, map each one to a DS token via Token MCP, flag values with no token match, and recommend the closest semantic token.

skills.name: state-matrix
skills.description: Generate the full interactive state grid for a Figma component (default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error, empty) with the token controlling the difference in each cell.

skills.name: design-critique
skills.description: Structured critique of a Figma frame against Design System rules. Covers visual hierarchy, spacing rhythm, alignment, density, component reuse and channel fit. Returns a categorised findings list with node IDs.

skills.name: a11y-check
skills.description: Design-time accessibility audit for a Figma frame. Checks colour contrast, text size, hit target size, focus indicator design, alt text placeholders, screen reader notes, and reduced-motion intent. Complements react/accessibility which covers WCAG 2.1 AA in implementation.

skills.name: content-style-check
skills.description: Run the copy in a Figma frame against the Design System content styleguide. Checks voice, tone, British English, brand name usage, em dash avoidance, headline structure, table label rules, and typography token description format.

skills.name: channel-context
skills.description: Validate channel colour usage in a Figma frame. Confirms the channel is declared at the right level, that semantic tokens flow from the channel, and that no cross-channel mixing occurs.

skills.name: spec-packet
skills.description: Bundle the outputs of frame-to-spec, state-matrix, token-mapping-audit, channel-context, plus asset export list and the Figma deep link, into a single Markdown packet ready to attach to an engineering ticket.

skills.name: light-dark-parity
skills.description: Compare light and dark frames of the same component, flag structural divergence, value divergence outside the documented channel exceptions, and missing dark variants. Enforces the 1:1 semantic token rule at design time.

skills.name: handoff-flow
skills.description: End-to-end orchestrator for the design-workflow skill suite. Runs every check and produces a complete handoff packet for a feature in one guided pass, stopping between phases for confirmation. Persists every artefact to .design/<feature>/.

skills.name: component-scaffold
skills.description: Scaffold a new Design System React component from a completed handoff packet. Creates the component file, CSS, story, docs MDX and changelog stub. Never invents, never overwrites, everything traces to upstream SPEC.md and STATE_MATRIX.md.

skills.name: code-connect-stub
skills.description: Generate the Figma Code Connect entry for a Design System component using the documentUrlSubstitutions in figma.config.json. Maps Figma component properties to React props, produces a .figma.tsx file alongside the component source.

skills.name: dev-spec
skills.description: Generate DEV-SPEC.html, the engineer's quick view of a generated screen or feature: components used with match status, tokens used with binding status, target surface, and open questions. Produced automatically alongside every full-page or feature generation, in the same sandbox run folder. The quick view, not the packet.

skills.name: visual-vs-built
skills.description: Compare a Figma frame against the live Storybook story for the same component. Structured diff covering token usage, spacing, typography, layout, with supporting fuzzy pixel diff. Catches drift after a component has landed in code.

skills.name: motion-tokens
skills.description: Reference and lookup skill for Design System motion tokens (durations, easings, named transitions). Mirrors reference/token-reference-fast-path but for motion. Returns deterministic tables. Currently scaffolded; fully active once motion tokens land in tokens.json.

skills.name: interaction-patterns
skills.description: Reference library of named interaction patterns (modal-open, toast-appear, optimistic-save, in-place-edit, sheet-drag, list-reorder, chip-toggle, hover-feedback, focus-ring-appear) with DS-recommended motion tokens and behavioural rules.

skills.name: prototype-spec
skills.description: Given a Figma prototype with smart animate or interactive components, emit a textual motion spec for engineering. Captures every animated property, duration, easing, trigger, and reduced-motion fallback.

skills.name: motion-review
skills.description: Score the motion in a Figma frame or prototype against Design System motion standards. Checks durations against the motion-token scale, easings against the standard set, reduced-motion fallback documentation, and divergence from interaction-patterns.

skills.name: monthly-audit
skills.description: Roll up every design-workflow finding across all features touched in the last month into a single Markdown digest with trends, top issues, and an action list. Designed to run on a scheduled task and feed a monthly retro.

skills.name: prototyping-agent
skills.description: Fast, conversational agent for early-stage design and prototyping. Loads Design DNA, then helps a designer iterate quickly on layout, tokens, interactions and motion ideas. Read-only, low-ceremony, designed for the first thirty minutes of a new design.

skills.name: critique-agent
skills.description: Read-only critique agent. Runs design-critique, a11y-check, content-style-check and light-dark-parity (when relevant) against a Figma frame, grounded in the Design DNA, and returns a consolidated findings report.

skills.name: handoff-agent
skills.description: Drives a Figma design to a complete engineering handoff packet. Composes the DNA preamble with token-mapping-audit, design-critique, a11y-check, content-style-check, light-dark-parity and frame-to-spec, then bundles PACKET.md.

skills.name: build-agent
skills.description: The only design agent that writes code. Takes an approved handoff packet and builds the React component end-to-end: scaffold, Code Connect stub, visual verification against Storybook. Requires approval at every write step; dry-run by default.

skills.name: design-rules
skills.description: The Design System rule set: eight categories of concrete, sourced design rules with IDs, severities and weights. Scoring backbone for design-critique and promotion target for corpus observations.

skills.name: corpus-guide
skills.description: The citation contract for the design corpus: how skills cite distilled evidence, what authority it carries, and how corpus versions are referenced.

skills.name: distill-corpus
skills.description: Turn a batch of real Brand product screenshots into versioned design knowledge: classify by surface/channel/journey, file with a content hash, distil into the corpus reference docs, and propose rule candidates.

skills.name: experience-principles
skills.description: Journey-level principles for new Brand experiences, extending the six DNA principles up to flows: modality heuristics, progressive disclosure, state completeness, subscription dignity, reader-first pacing and continuity. Preamble for the other ux/ skills.

skills.name: flow-design
skills.description: Turn an experience brief into a designed flow for a new Brand experience: screen sequence, states, decision points, component mapping and open questions, grounded in Mobbin prior art and the design corpus. The entry skill for the new-experience route.

skills.name: pattern-library
skills.description: Catalogue of Brand experience patterns one altitude above component motions: navigation, content lists and cards, article anatomy, forms and auth, paywall and subscriber touchpoints, the empty/error/loading trio, and live-updating content. Each pattern names its anatomy in DS components, states, a11y and motion.

skills.name: page-templates
skills.description: Page-level layout templates for Brand experiences on the DS responsive grid: article, section front, media, account and settings, and puzzle hub, each with per-viewport reflow. Grounded in the grid reference and the corpus.

skills.name: microcopy
skills.description: Author the interface copy for a product experience - button labels, form labels, errors, empty states, confirmations, permission asks and paywall copy - in the brand voice. Writes the words; ui/content-style-check checks them. Extends content-styleguide.md to product-surface microcopy.
